_doc: The street furniture of one regional style (city.style; the same views in style_eua_plan.json and style_europa_plan.json): two avenues crossed on bare land, their junction signalled, hydrants, post boxes, lamps and signs laid by the style's tables; the junction, a corner close, the corner at night, and the corner again in a 25 m/s wind (the signal sways, props.gdshader).
